name: Remix Wizard Chess 3D
description:
Interactive 3D Gothic Cathedral Wizard Chess with sculpted stone pieces, cinematic melee captures, stone shatter physics, and single-player AI.

add two player online real time play and turn based pausing of gameplay for extended periods. the app should remind on a 15, 30, or 60 minute configurable interval whichever player whose turn it is. there should also be a configurable indefinite pause option that can save a game through many hours of being away from it and allow gameplay to resume timer based countdowns on the intervals above, at the chosen expiration time of indefinitie pause, to encourage the game to pick back up naturally at the acceptable times while allowing players to suspend play for another 2 hours for 5 turns after a maximum 24 hour "indefinite" pause elapses. this version is also enabled with visual learning mode, where a player can explore tactics and approaches both well established and also novel.m, with the focus being on learning the basics of established competitive gameplay that shows and enabled the player to chose an opening. or counter, etc. from a short list of winning strategies. for instance, I open with opening x, and the. the timer starts for player 2. player 2 is offered 3 top approaches to the next several moves, dependent on the techniques inherit moves or necessary actions. the guidance should show in a time elapsing simulation of the moves the player must be attempting as the core of the strategy, at least the next 2 but up to 7 moves determined by probability of a seasoned opponent well versed  in the known methods/openings. this simulation of moves will not be exact per SE but should quickly and clearly visually  by showing an elapsing of probable or plausible turns highlighting the specific actions the strategy is going to require to be effective. and accompanied by  brief concise text suitable for all ages of players to understand quickly what is involved,
